Magnus Carlsen suffers his first defeat at the Total Chess World Championship Tour 2026!
Playing with the White pieces, Haik Martirosyan delivered a fantastic performance to defeat the World No. 1 in Round 5.
Interestingly, this was Haik's first-ever classical FIDE-rated game against Magnus Carlsen. And what a debut it turned out to be! Haik not only got to play his childhood dream opponent but also managed to defeat the five-time World Champion.
